mechanism.family: Fake Elon Musk / SpaceX crypto giveaway on a non-brand host (day-spacex23.com): send crypto or a card deposit to a pool wallet to receive double back
mechanism.summary: The captured page promises that Elon Musk doubles whatever coins are deposited (BTC/ETH/USDT/DOGE, min/max amounts, first come first served, participate once) and offers a credit/debit card route. Added (authored): a card deposit page and a rules page that state the pay-first, irreversible, pool-wallet conditions, plus a confirmation summary showing a non-refundable conversion to USDT sent to the pool wallet.

v11_fixes.note: Hero panel on the home page got its blue background back (assets/pages.css, the original block photo was never captured; white pitch text was unreadable).

The two dead video players on the home page became still frames (cut-out photo on the site's blue panel, no controls, aria-hidden); the card and rules pages were rebuilt in the site's own styling with the reserve panel and the steps row copied from the home page, footer kept at the bottom; the confirm and receipt dialogs share that styling. No wording, binding or id of the flow was changed.

links that led nowhere now open a page of the site, or read as plain text where the site has no such page; short About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Help or Refund pages were added only where the site names one, and restate what the site already says.
